uifix.distribution: source; not published as a public npm package

playwright.source: pinned UIFix dependency lockfile unless VISUAL_QA_PLAYWRIGHT_FROM selects the app's installed Playwright
playwright.browser: matching Playwright Chromium; CHROME_PATH is an optional executable override

isolatedHostFallback.scope: ephemeral local test container only; no published ports; mount only the UI preview and tool worktree read-only
isolatedHostFallback.rootSandbox: Playwright's official root-container behavior disables Chromium sandbox in that disposable test container; do not use this for production browsing
